remediation: Pre-core pointercancel wrapper preserves v0.1.1 cleanup while making cancelled gestures ineligible to commit tap orders.
acceptance: Raw pointercancel is telemetry; fail only on Commander order from cancel, retained pointer capture after cleanup, unrecovered subsequent input, lifecycle interruption, or WebGL context loss.
retainedEvidence: LW-0A-001 supplies unchanged renderer/simulation 20-minute channel performance and stability evidence.
